goals.goal: Maintain a processor contract with each sub-processor (currently the external payment provider) containing the Art. 28(3)(a)–(h) eight-element closed-list clauses (documented instructions, confidentiality, Art. 32 measures, sub-processor authorisation, data-subject-rights assistance, incident assistance, deletion-or-return, audit/inspection); maintain an Art. 46 appropriate-safeguards instrument for any third-country transfer lacking an adequacy decision; apply an Art. 48 filter that recognises third-country court or administrative requests for personal-data disclosure only through an international-agreement basis.
goals.adjustment: Restated from corpus requirement 6.3.1 to the company's single-sub-processor (payment-provider) scale; the DPA matrix reduces to one processor contract; Art. 46/48 apply conditionally on hosting or payment-provider jurisdiction outside the EEA.

goals.goal: As manufacturer of a default-class product with digital elements, upon identifying a vulnerability in an integrated component, report it to the person or entity manufacturing or maintaining that component and address and remediate it in accordance with Annex I Part II; Art. 19 importer pre-market verification and Art. 20 distributor due-care and non-conformity escalation duties apply to downstream economic operators in the supply chain, not to the manufacturer.
goals.adjustment: Restated from corpus requirement 6.3.3 to the manufacturer role; Art. 13(6) is the directly operative obligation for TinyTask; Art. 19/20 are scoped to downstream importers/distributors and retained for supply-chain completeness per the DIFFERENT-PERSPECTIVE CRDA classification.
